title: CBAM supplier data missing? Check the O3CI handoff
description: CBAM data shared but not verified? Check the supplier handoff, separate verification status and download a free supplier request template.
intro: Your supplier says the data was shared, but the importer cannot find it. Start by separating portal access, installation identity and data-sharing issues. This tool checks your answers, not the official registry.
privacy: No login, uploads or personal information. Your answers stay in this page and are never sent. We only count page views, checklist runs and downloads, without cookies.
items: Does the non-EU installation operator have working O3CI access?
Ask the operator to check EU Login, two-factor authentication and the access request status.
Have both parties agreed which installation record they mean?
Ask for the installation reference and a named data owner; avoid exchanging unrelated factory records.
Has the declarant shared the correct EORI with the operator?
Confirm the declarant identity and EORI directly through your trusted business contact.
Has the operator confirmed the relevant emissions data is shared?
Ask which record and reporting period were shared, with whom and when.
Can the declarant retrieve the record from the registry?
Ask the declarant to check the third-country installation search in the Emissions area.
empty: Choose a status for each item, then run the check.
done: All five items are marked confirmed by you. That is not proof of compliance or verified emissions.
limit: This checklist does not validate registry access, documents, verification, calculations or an official declaration.
explain: The Commission describes O3CI as a route for non-EU operators to share installation and emissions information with declarants. It specifically notes that declarants must communicate their EORI to the supplier outside the registry. Check that handoff before resending files.
faqs: Does this tool submit anything to the EU?
No. It only prepares a local coordination checklist. Use the official registry for official actions.
No. Registry sharing is not independent verification. If using actual emissions, consult the Commission's rules for accredited independent verifiers; this checker cannot verify emissions.
Does a missing verification report in September 2026 prove a failure?
No. The Commission's published timeline places the first verification reports in January 2027. Ask for the status and expected availability, rather than assuming a report must already exist.
What should I ask my supplier to send next?

Start with one installation and reporting period. Ask for the sharing recipient, retrieval status and, where actual emissions are planned, the verification owner and report status. Use the free request template and an agreed secure channel.
Can I buy the €299 evidence pack here?
Not yet. €299 is an indicative pilot price, not an active checkout. The separate EcoBack storage membership is not this evidence pack.
offer: The checklist and supplier request template are free. A proposed €299 evidence-pack pilot would organise one product family's bilingual document index and tailored follow-up list. It is not verification or a declaration service. Scope, tax treatment and delivery terms must be agreed before any charge; checkout is not connected.
scopeContact: Ask about the scope — not an order
scopeContactNote: The contact page is in German. Do not send sensitive files in an initial enquiry. No payment is collected here.

request.title: CBAM data shared but not verified: what to request
request.intro: Treat this as a coordination question, not a failed-compliance verdict. The next step depends on where the handoff stopped.
steps: Confirm the installation, reporting period and intended recipient together. A resent spreadsheet does not show that the right registry record is visible.
If actual emissions are planned, identify the verification owner and report status. Sharing a record does not replace an accredited independent verifier.
Record the planned next step and expected availability. The Commission's timeline puts first reports in January 2027; do not mark an absent report in September 2026 as an automatic failure.
request.note: Editable text with blank placeholders. Complete it locally and review it before sending. EcoBack does not send messages or upload your files.
template: We are coordinating information for [product family] from [installation reference], for [reporting period]. Please help us confirm the following items through our agreed business channel.
1. Installation: confirm the reference, country and person responsible for this record.
2. Sharing: confirm which record and period were shared, the intended declarant and the date. Confirm EORI directly through the trusted business contact; do not post it publicly.
3. Retrieval: [declarant contact] to confirm whether that exact record is visible. If not, please describe the unresolved step without sharing account credentials.

4. If actual emissions are planned: identify the verification contact and current report status. If a report is not yet available, please state the next step and expected availability. This request does not assume the report is already due.
5. Agree one owner and next action for each unresolved item. Please reply by [business coordination date — not a legal deadline].
Please do not send passwords or personal identification documents with this initial reply. Agree a secure channel before transferring sensitive evidence.
Preparation template only. Not an EU form, legal advice, verification or proof of compliance. Do not submit this template as a CBAM declaration.

disclaimer: Independent preparation aid. Not an EU service, legal advice, certification, verification or a compliance decision.
boundary: For teams already considering the O3CI sharing route. This is not an assessment of whether your goods fall within CBAM, whether an exemption applies, or whether O3CI registration is mandatory for your business.
next: Choose one product family and one installation to troubleshoot first.
Record the problem, owner and next step for each unanswered item.
Keep sensitive supporting documents in an agreed secure channel, not a public group.
